x: M.S. in Environment and Energy (Jeonbuk National University, 2026) with a B.S. in Mineral Resources and Energy Engineering. As an undergraduate researcher I wrote a first-author paper interpreting seismic images of large overseas CO2 storage sites in light of plate-tectonic history, and in the IAB convergence-major capstone I designed and trained a spatiotemporal deep learning model (U-LSTM) that predicts wildfire spread. In my master's I separated overlapping gravity and magnetic signals with wavenumber-domain correlation analysis and published a first-author paper in SPE Journal (SCIE); across both degrees: 3 papers, 6 conference presentations and a best student paper award. At the POSCO Youth AI & Big Data Academy (with POSTECH) I built the training data and ran model experiments for an English expression correction system (FLAN-T5 + RAG) that won an Excellence Award, and at the Samsung Software & AI Academy for Youth (SSAFY) I am building LLM data pipelines and multimodal model ensembles. Two research stays at the University of Calgary; ADsP (Advanced Data Analytics Semi-Professional) certified.
